reviewer.role: independent engineering reviewer; separate context; read-only except this report
reviewer.model: Codex, GPT-6 family; exact inherited model deployment identifier not exposed to reviewer

timing.limitation: No initial clock marker or billing/token telemetry available; no elapsed labor estimate invented.

findings.issue: Malformed Pinakes instrument_id array caused unhandled TypeError, blocking materialization and ordinary checker job.
findings.reproduction: Set fixture fragment instrument_id=[]; previous helper raised TypeError: unhashable type: list.
findings.resolution: Root added string-identity guard matching source adapter; final 29 focused tests pass.

findings.issue: Ordinary job.py invokes helper without resume; repeated jobs with more than eight artifacts or invocation bytes can revisit prefix and defer same tail indefinitely.
findings.current_impact: None for five artifacts totaling 271942 bytes. API resume works in tests.
findings.resolution: Root reports separate Sol handoff via PR103 comment6511840662; no automatic tail completion claim. Operator/helper cursor use must remain explicit.

findings.issue: Raw Pinakes SHA compared to normalized claim SHA; uppercase valid metadata SHA recognized by native source adapter is missed by helper.
findings.current_impact: No current-corpus effect; eligible current metadata is lowercase.
findings.reproduction: Uppercase fixture data.sha256 with unchanged claim SHA yields no_matching_cited_replica.
findings.recommended_action: Normalize and validate fragment digest using native sha_hex semantics, or explicitly document strict lowercase requirement.
findings.resolution: Root normalizes and validates fragment SHA before association matching/path hash conflict checks; whitespace/uppercase regression passes.

findings.issue: Second visible baseline already held EO4782 bytes, so it could not support incremental benefit; independently flagged to root. Earlier run also rejected input drift while tests were edited.
findings.resolution: Both failed attempts retained. Final exclusive replay asserts both additional PDFs absent before and after baseline; final baseline shows ten custody-only references and corrected shows ten held references. All 699 pinned inputs independently match current files.
findings.causality_limit: Cause of earlier concurrent source change remains unidentified; no claim it was fixed by a code change.

assessed_controls: Last filename/physical-line valid claim selection and canonical hashes match current native checker/tracker corpus.
Only native recognized source/source-list fields enter selection; confirmation hashes do not.
Pinakes exact producer, kind, grade and acceptable_as_original=False required.
Selected claim identity, reference identity and allowed path checked; conflicting associations refused.
Selected bytes must match both source SHA256 and exact pinned Git blob, including already-present files.
PDF count, per-PDF and per-invocation byte bounds are enforced for normal immutable inputs; deferrals retain cursor.
Shared identical PDF within explicit same-path associations read once and every selected claim reference retained.
Resume binds commit, all claim/association input hashes and selected artifacts; prefix states expressly not reverified.
Traversal, symlink, missing path/object, wrong hash/format, LFS pointer and local overwrite refusals covered by code/tests.
qualifications: No legal review, original authentication, grade promotion, human certification or source website acquisition performed.
Census eligibility is five retained artifacts, not five additional beneficiaries; only two additional current ProQuest custody holds beyond original three.

Generic malformed claim handling is intentionally stricter than native checker: helper aborts selection before restoration rather than skipping malformed records. Current census has zero malformed records.
Tracker BOM behavior differs from checker outside current corpus; BOM test validates helper/checker parsing and physical line tracking, not universal tracker parser equivalence.
EO254 inventory duplicate has same Git blob; current Pinakes association chooses one path, so selected artifact is deduplicated.
Pins describe worktree versions; parent owns register/handoff integration and commit.

remaining_hold.detail: working_text_fragment_identity_or_grade_mismatch on all five source references; source custody repair does not waive this policy.

native_replay.boundaries: Five-case isolated native checker/tracker overlay only. EO4782 is one additional ready row in this replay; EO1547 remains held. No canonical tracker publication or global readiness delta claimed.

source_census_final_amendment.scope: Updated source_census.py and SOURCE_ASSOCIATIONS.json only; no native replay rerun; helper/tests/replay review unchanged.
checks: Non-ProQuest classifier return is outside copy/path loops and handles no-copy metadata; four small metadata-only classification probes pass.
Repository-file routes are now explicitly repository_copy_reported_unhashed; a pinned/visible path is not labeled an independently rehashed local file.
Artifact-row recount equals 802 unique hashes; reference-row weights sum to 10928 and equal all category totals.
Five ProQuest PDFs are local_exact_available only in current post-restoration state; earlier five-absent retained-Git baseline remains separately labeled.
Only original five ProQuest identities appear as eligible candidates; additional IDs remain EO1547 and EO4782. No additional non-ProQuest beneficiary or readiness claim is introduced.
source_census_final_amendment.count_qualification: Per-category distinct claim counts 5/35/91/596 overlap; they must not be summed as distinct beneficiaries. Artifact/reference totals were independently recounted; distinct-claim aggregation was reviewed in code, not rerun against every reference during this small amendment.
source_census_final_amendment.native_outcome_unchanged: Two additional custody repairs; one additional ready row (EO4782) in isolated replay, with EO1547 still held.
